title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.96
summary: Live-Ton repariert: lokale Liveansicht und Cloud erhalten auf Anforderung eine echte AAC-HLS-Audiospur; Vorschau/Kiosk bleiben stabil stumm.
changes: Restore explicit live audio mode in both native Live page and private PHP cloud viewer
Fix missing audioEnabled in public camera stream session responses, which made cloud audio always appear unavailable
Attach optional AAC branch even when video broker was previously initialized without sound or ONVIF audio metadata is missing
Verify actual AAC track in completed local HLS segment before advertising sound capability
Keep default permanent preview and kiosk streams video-only and make local Safari audio playback opt-in with explicit speaker gesture
Add audio session regression tests while preserving MySQL, NAS archives, original camera data and cloud registration
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.96
description: Fix live camera audio transport and verified HLS sound in both native frontend and private HTTPS cloud
releaseNotes: Keep private Plesk PHP 3.1.1 unchanged. Upgrade camera server to 2.20.96. Open camera live view and request audio using the speaker control; a second tap may be necessary on iPhone. Requires a working camera microphone track. No production iPhone audio test has been performed.
